notes: Item text is verbatim from the printed 'Requirement' column. The 'ref' field is the clause code printed to the left of (or immediately above, for grouped items) each row; where several consecutive rows share one printed ref (a group heading such as '7.1.1 A.3 Compulsory in all cases:'), that ref is repeated on every item in the group.

Every row in the printed form that carries its own PASSED/FAILED/blank (or Yes/No, or Existent/Non-existent) marking box is captured as one item, including sub-bullets nested under a group heading. Bare section titles with no marking box of their own (e.g. 'Descriptive markings', 'Indicating device') are NOT counted as items — they are captured only in the 'section' field of the items that follow them.

answerType values used: 'yes-no-na' (PASSED/FAILED/blank, the normal checklist row — R 76-2 p.5 marking convention: X in PASSED, X in FAILED, or '– –' if not applicable), 'yes-no' (an explicit Yes/No choice printed on the row itself, distinct from PASSED/FAILED), 'existent-non-existent' (a device-presence declaration checkbox, per the R 76-2 p.49 checklist preamble: 'the checklist provides space to indicate whether or not the device exists ... A cross in the box for existent indicates that the device exists'), 'type-selection' (a multi-choice field, e.g. Subtractive/Additive), 'measurement' (a numeric field, not a pass/fail box).

Data storage devices (DSD)
DSD realized with embedded software (examine software acc. to G.1)
DSD realized with programmable/loadable software (examine software acc. to G.1)
documentation with all relevant information
sufficient storage capacity for the intended purpose
data are stored and given back correctly
sufficient description of measures to prevent data loss

storage of all relevant information necessary to reconstruct an earlier weighing, i.e. gross, net, tare values, decimal signs, units, identifications of the data set, instrument number, load receptor, (if applicable), checksum / signature of the data set stored
protection of the stored legally relevant data against accidental or intentional changes
protection of the stored legally relevant data at least with a parity check during transmission to the storage device
protection of the stored legally relevant data at least with a parity check of a storage device with embedded software (5.5.1)
protection of the stored legally relevant data by an adequate checksum or of a storage device with programmable or loadable software (5.5.2)
identification and indication of the stored legally relevant data with an identification number
record of the identification number on the official transaction medium, i.e. on the print-out
automatic storage of the legally relevant data
a device subject to legal control prints or displays the stored legally relevant data for verifying
